AND gb.target_quantity > 0 AND gb.current_quantity >= gb.target_quantity
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection}, gb.group_buy_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT gb.group_buy_id, gb.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_name_jp, p.brand, p.thumbnail_url, p.price_jpy, gb.title, gb.description, gb.target_quantity, gb.current_quantity, gb.start_date, gb.end_date, gb.status, gb.created_at, gb.updated_at, m.member_id AS creator_id, m.name AS creator_name, m.email AS creator_email, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_BUY_PARTICIPANT gp WHERE gp.group_buy_id = gb.group_buy_id AND gp.participation_status = 'JOINED' ) AS participant_count FROM GROUP_BUY gb JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = gb.product_id LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON m.member_id = gb.creator_id WHERE gb.group_buy_id = #{groupBuyId}
